title: Ultrasonic cool mist humidifier
text: Ultrasonic cool mist humidifier. As humidifiers go, I think this a good one.  For air quality safety they recommend daily cleaning.  I admit I do it about once a week... using vinegar and water.  This helps to kills fungus, mold and other bacteria.  I purchased two for my tiny house... one for the living area and one for the bedroom.  I ran them 24/7 for about a week and saw a very, very small improvement in the actual humidity of the air.  So... I have since stopped using them unless something has a head cold or something.  And I wash before every fill.  Allowing them to thoroughly dry before putting away.  They are a good size, taking a very small foot print area.  On the "low setting" I got over 10 hours of run time.  You can "see" the cool steam and the top has turnable direction flat so you can point the steam in the direction desired.  It makes very little noise while running.  All in all, if you want to run an occasional humidifier, this one will most likely work.  If you want to run one that will actually raise your humidity, you might want to consider something more commercial?  That is just my opinion.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
